insurer: TATA AIG General Insurance Company Ltd.

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed this limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye; modern treatments up to 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; listed modern/day-care procedures capped at 50% of SI

ped_waiting.note: Only PEDs declared and accepted are covered after 36 months; reducible via portability credit

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, ENT, tumours, etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Code-Excl 18

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.note: All day-care procedures covered; listed modern treatments also covered up to 50% of SI

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient and day-care covered; pre-hosp 30 days and post-hosp 60 days also covered for AYUSH; assessed per Ministry of AYUSH benchmark rates

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: Listed procedures (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded under Annexure-A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded; all treatment must be within India

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (including portability/migration), no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: From date of receipt of policy document

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferred

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, treatment outside India, sterility/infertility, refractive error <7.5D, existing disclosed diseases (specific ICD codes)
